content.short: A Mushroom-based NFT series you can GROW and BREED!
content.description:
In February, 2021 during the height of the COVID pandemic, Mophizo was scrambling to get their newly designed mRNA vaccines out to the population. In their haste Mophizo had outsourced hiring to a rather shady company (likely mob connected), who in turn hired less than sanitary employees (how should we say - dirty hippies) to help bottle the newly released designer vax.

Nobody can pinpoint the exact day, but it is well known that many of the employees regularly ingested some rather gnarly psychedelic mushrooms, and in the process spores went airborne and wafted in to the mRNA concoction.

Later that month, as the new vax was making it's way out to people around the world, the batch from Mophizo landed on shelves - little did they know a hidden transformation lurked…

Mushroom Mutants is a fun mushroom NFT project launching on Cardano. The basic idea is buyers will purchase a mRNA syringe from us, which will then grow to a full Mushroom Mutant. It is meant to explore the world of mushroom mutations and crazy crosses! Gen1 is being sold as full grown mutants to get the ball rolling.
